changes: First version: three audio-track LFO waveforms with a loop of remembered random values. DJV steps, DJQ plays root, fifth and octaves on PTCH (whole knob steps elsewhere), DJC glides. SPD (DEJA) sets how often a slot is replayed instead of renewed, MULT the loop length (1..64), TRIG what moves through it: FREE every step, HOLD one value per step played by trigs, ONE one slot per trig, TRIG and HALF restart on a trig. Emulator evidence only; hardware not tested.
